create_scene_viz: create a SceneViz instance to initialize a 3D matplotlib figure for visualization
draw_camera_pyramid: draw a camera pyramid at a given pose with configurable size and color
draw_axes_at_pose: draw RGB coordinate axes at a given SE3 pose with a specified length
draw_marker_outline: draw a square marker outline at a given pose with optional ID label
show_3d_scene: render the 3D scene with auto-scaled axis limits and display the plot
